platformAdminWelcome.title: You are the platform administrator
platformAdminWelcome.body: Signing in made you this deployment's platform administrator. You hold every capability here, including the org, role, and user administration surfaces — nobody else can claim it now.
platformAdminWelcome.orgHeading: Nothing to invite anyone to yet
platformAdminWelcome.orgBody: Being the platform administrator is not membership in an organization — you hold none, and none exist for anyone else to join. People are invited into an organization, so create one first.
platformAdminWelcome.orgStep2: Create an organization and choose whether to seed it with demo data.
platformAdminWelcome.orgStep3: From that organization's Team page, invite people into it with the role you want them to hold — signing in through an invite never makes anyone a platform administrator.
